notes: Eight own pages read, all HTTP 200 and not thin: the canonical-domain home (sectra.com, group site) and seven Sectra Medical pages. The page-candidates home field pointed at a KLAS page and was ignored. 'Sectra PACS' and 'Sectra AB' are the vendor's index aliases and were treated as name mentions, not product_names claims; 'Sectra Radiology PACS' was likewise treated as the vendor name plus a category word. KLAS awards, scores, loyalty percentages, consideration shares, cost multiples (three to seven times) and implementation timelines are ratings, comparisons or out-of-scope facts and were not coded. The q3 line that enterprise PACS 'like Sectra' are usually cost-prohibitive due to upfront licensing was treated as a hedged generalisation, not a pricing statement. Module coverage lists (radiology, cardiology, pathology and so on) were treated as capability descriptions. C02 (on-premise) rests on Sectra's own 2022 article describing a hybrid with the customer's on-premises solution; no page read states the on-premises option in a product page. No claim is wrong or stale, so no cited page was read for causes. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser read exists for Sectra and no page was blocked or thin, so nothing was re-classed; the eight snapshots were re-checked for C07 to C09, C11 and C12 and still do not settle them (the menus list Sectra One Cloud, IDS7, UniView, Reporting, Amplifier Services, Image Exchange Portal, VNA and DoseTrack, but no Sectra One, Radiology Suite, RIS, Secure Desktop or Teleradiology product). The 34 gap lines are best-for, KLAS, cost-comparison, capability, generic RIS/EHR/DICOM/HL7 integration or other-vendor lines; the 'Sectra One' and 'Sectra RIS-PACS' gap lines come from answers already listed under C07 and C09. Table scan: added C16 from the q7 Claude run 1 Sectra-versus-Visage table cell 'Cloud-Native | Partial' (unverifiable); the other Sectra column cells are KLAS rankings, relative cost multiples, rendering architecture ('Hybrid/Client-Server') or feature ratings, and the deployment cells were already coded under C01 to C03. No claim is wrong or stale, so the consistency check changed nothing.
